comment: Recorded exceptions for lint_kubejs_traps.js. An entry tolerates exactly `count` sites of one rule in one file (path below kubejs/). One more site flags the whole file+rule; no site left flags the entry itself. Every entry needs a reason; add `owed` when the exception is a known defect waiting for a decision rather than accepted code.

exceptions.reason: KNOWN DEFECT, deliberately not fixed here: all four chat branches (!ascension, !ascend, !ascension-set, !ascension-reset) call event.cancel() first, so Ascension has never been reachable.
exceptions.owed: Operator decision. The fix is to move four lines, but it switches on a permanent, irreversible per-world difficulty change that has never run. Fix the script (cancel last) and delete this entry in the same commit, or retire the feature.
